taskDescription:
Implement Sprint 00: Project Foundation for LedgerLens - a Kotlin Multiplatform personal finance app.

CONTEXT:
- This is a greenfield project with only documentation currently
- Must follow the implementation plans in docs/implementation-plan/00-project-foundation/
- Target: Android + Desktop (Windows/macOS/Linux) using Compose Multiplatform
- Database: SQLDelight with SQLCipher encryption
- Must use TDD approach with >80% coverage

REFERENCE DOCUMENTS:
- docs/implementation-plan/00-project-foundation/01-kmp-project-setup.md
- docs/implementation-plan/00-project-foundation/02-build-configuration.md
- docs/implementation-plan/00-project-foundation/03-development-tooling.md
- docs/implementation-plan/00-project-foundation/04-ci-cd-pipeline.md
- docs/PRDs/13-architecture-decision-records.md (for ADR-001 through ADR-007)

features.description: Feature 1: KMP Project Setup - Create Kotlin Multiplatform project structure with shared/, android/, desktop/ modules, Gradle Kotlin DSL configuration, and basic entry points per 01-kmp-project-setup.md
Feature 2: Build Configuration - Set up version catalog (libs.versions.toml), Android build variants, Desktop packaging, ProGuard rules, and signing configuration per 02-build-configuration.md
Feature 3: Development Tooling - Configure ktlint, detekt, pre-commit hooks, Dokka documentation, and IDE configuration files per 03-development-tooling.md
Feature 4: CI/CD Pipeline - Create GitHub Actions workflows (ci.yml, release.yml), Dependabot configuration, and document branch protection rules per 04-ci-cd-pipeline.md
